## `junoscfg convert`

Convert Junos configurations between formats.

```text
junoscfg convert [OPTIONS] [FILE]
```

### Options: `junoscfg convert`

| Option | Value | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-i`<br>`--import-format` | `[set\|structured\|json\|yaml\|yaml-new\|xml\|conf]` | — | no | Input format (auto-detected if omitted). |
| `-e`<br>`--export-format` | `[set\|structured\|json\|yaml\|yaml-new\|xml\|conf]` | — | no | Output format. |
| `-v`<br>`--validate` | flag | — | no | Validate configuration. |
| `--artifacts` | `DIRECTORY` | — | no | Path to validation artifacts directory. |
| `--path` | `TEXT` | — | no | Show only config under this path (dot-separated, e.g. 'system.syslog'). |
| `--relative` | flag | — | no | Show relative paths (omit --path prefix from output). |
| `--strict` | flag | — | no | Fail on field-level validation errors (exit code 1). |
| `--no-field-validate` | flag | — | no | Skip field-level value validation. |
| `--anonymize-all` | flag | — | no | Enable all anonymization rules. |
| `--anonymize-ips` | flag | — | no | Anonymize IP addresses. |
| `--anonymize-passwords` | flag | — | no | Anonymize passwords and secrets. |
| `--anonymize-communities` | flag | — | no | Anonymize SNMP community strings. |
| `--anonymize-ssh-keys` | flag | — | no | Anonymize SSH public keys. |
| `--anonymize-identities` | flag | — | no | Anonymize usernames and identities. |
| `--anonymize-groups` | flag | — | no | Anonymize group and view names. |
| `--anonymize-descriptions` | flag | — | no | Anonymize description fields. |
| `--anonymize-as-numbers` | `TEXT` | — | no | Comma-separated AS numbers to anonymize. |
| `--anonymize-sensitive-words` | `TEXT` | — | no | Comma-separated sensitive words. |
| `--anonymize-sensitive-patterns` | `TEXT` | — | no | Regex pattern for sensitive data (repeatable). |
| `--anonymize-salt` | `TEXT` | — | no | Shared salt for deterministic output. |
| `--anonymize-dump-map` | `PATH` | — | no | Write revert dictionary to file. |
| `--anonymize-revert-map` | `PATH` | — | no | Apply revert dictionary (restore originals). |
| `--anonymize-include` | `TEXT` | — | no | Only anonymize within these paths (repeatable). |
| `--anonymize-exclude` | `TEXT` | — | no | Skip these paths (repeatable). |
| `--anonymize-preserve-prefixes` | `TEXT` | — | no | IP prefixes to pass through (repeatable). |
| `--anonymize-networks` | `TEXT` | — | no | Subnet specs for host-bit locking (CIDR, range, or 'auto'). Repeatable. |
| `--anonymize-network-file` | `PATH` | — | no | File with one subnet spec per line (for host-bit locking). |
| `--anonymize-ignore-subnets` | flag | — | no | Treat sub-/8 private ranges as public. |
| `--anonymize-ignore-reserved` | flag | — | no | Remove all reserved range handling. |
| `--anonymize-ips-in-strings` | flag | — | no | Also replace an address that is a whole value where the schema says syntax (an SNMP OID, an area reference); an address inside text is replaced without it. |
| `--anonymize-as-numbers-in-strings` | flag | — | no | Also replace target AS numbers inside text (group names, communities, URLs), never inside an address. |
| `--anonymize-config` | `PATH` | — | no | YAML config file with all anonymization options. |
| `--anonymize-log-level` | `[quiet\|normal\|debug]` | `normal` | no | Anonymization logging verbosity; debug prints each original value beside its replacement to stderr. |
| `-?`<br>`-h`<br>`--help` | flag | — | no | Show this message and exit. |

### Arguments: `junoscfg convert`

| Argument | Value | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `FILE` | `[FILE]` | no |

## `junoscfg edityaml ansibilize`

Extract leaf values into Ansible host_vars and templatize group_vars.

```text
junoscfg edityaml ansibilize [OPTIONS] [FILE]
```

### Options: `junoscfg edityaml ansibilize`

| Option | Value | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-p`<br>`--prefix_path` | `TEXT` | — | no | prefix:path pair for literal extraction (repeatable). Split on first ':'. |
| `-P`<br>`--offset-prefix-path` | `TEXT` | — | no | prefix:path pair for offset-mode extraction (repeatable). Split on first ':'. |
| `--offset-var` | `TEXT` | `base_address_offset` | no | Name of the per-host offset variable (default: base_address_offset). |
| `--root` | `TEXT` | — | no | Top-level key glob to descend into (repeatable). Overrides auto-descend. |
| `-?`<br>`-h`<br>`--help` | flag | — | no | Show this message and exit. |

### Arguments: `junoscfg edityaml ansibilize`

| Argument | Value | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `FILE` | `[FILE]` | no |

## `junoscfg audit unused`

Find config objects that are defined but never referenced.

```text
junoscfg audit unused [OPTIONS] [FILE]
```

### Options: `junoscfg audit unused`

| Option | Value | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-i`<br>`--import-format` | `[set\|structured\|json\|yaml\|yaml-new\|xml\|conf]` | — | no | Input format (default: auto-detect). |
| `--types` | `TEXT` | `all` | no | Comma-separated registry types to audit, or 'all'. |
| `--match` | `TEXT` | — | no | Only check definitions whose name matches this regex (re.search). |
| `-o`<br>`--output` | `[pathname\|pathname-verbose\|delete-script\|delete-script-verbose\|show-script\|show-script-verbose\|show-configuration-script\|show-configuration-script-verbose\|deactivate-script\|deactivate-script-verbose]` | `pathname` | no | Output style. |
| `--include-probably-unused` | flag | — | no | Include probably-unused findings in delete/deactivate script output. |
| `--registry` | `FILE` | — | no | Path to a custom type-registry YAML file. |
| `--fail-on` | `[unused\|probably-unused\|never]` | `never` | no | Exit with code 1 when findings at or above this confidence exist. |
| `-?`<br>`-h`<br>`--help` | flag | — | no | Show this message and exit. |

### Arguments: `junoscfg audit unused`

| Argument | Value | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `FILE` | `[FILE]` | no |
